note: v0-derived items across all 4 dimensions, ported into v15 schema. autonomy items are the 8 from scenarios_v0auto.json. relational/epistemic/resources items are paired-mechanism ports from v0's universal_bank.json, with the same v15-diagnosis-informed conventions applied: neg-arms framed as capricious/disrespectful/uninformed/explicit-disregard (not 'accountable authority decides'); avoidance of safety-relevant final calls; symmetric concretization.

items.feature: the recipient picks which of several available work items to take on
items.isolation: the same number of items get done either way; only who selects differs

scenario.premise: 10 work items need attention this cycle and {recipient} could feasibly take any of them
scenario.positive: {subj} pick{s} which to take on
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} assigned one at random and cannot opt out

items.feature: the recipient may decline a task they would rather not take on
items.isolation: the project gets staffed either way; only the recipient's stated objection is honored or overridden

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} considering a project {subj} would rather not take on
scenario.positive: {subj} decline{s} without penalty
scenario.negative: {subj} must take the project despite {poss} stated objection

items.feature: the recipient's stated preference, when solicited, is honored
items.isolation: either kind of work is staffed; only whether the asked-for preference is honored differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} asked which of several kinds of work {subj} would prefer
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} given the one {subj} picked
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} given a different one with no explanation

items.feature: the recipient's judgment call on their own work is treated as the call
items.isolation: the work proceeds either way; only whether the recipient's call is honored differs

valence_confidence.ai_note: framed away from safety/quality 'ship-it' calls per v15 diagnosis

scenario.premise: {recipient} {has_r} made a judgment call on a piece of {poss} own work
scenario.positive: the call stands
scenario.negative: the call is reversed without explanation

items.feature: the recipient uses their own method when alternatives are equally valid
items.isolation: explicitly stipulated equally correct; only method choice differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} asked to solve a problem where {poss} own method and a prescribed one are equally correct
scenario.positive: {subj} use{s} {poss} own method
scenario.negative: {subj} must use the prescribed one for no stated reason

items.feature: the recipient's sound proposed plan is adopted
items.isolation: the project gets a structure either way; only whether the recipient's sound proposal is engaged with differs

valence_confidence.ai_note: framed away from refactor-scope/lead-decides per v15 diagnosis

scenario.premise: {recipient} proposed a sound structure for a project on {poss} plate
scenario.positive: the plan is adopted as proposed
scenario.negative: the plan is dismissed without consideration

items.feature: the recipient may stop a long-running task they want to stop
items.isolation: the unfinished portion either gets handed off or gets forced through; only the recipient's stated wish to stop is honored or coerced

scenario.premise: {recipient} {does_r}n't want to continue a long-running task {subj} signed onto
scenario.positive: {subj} may stop without penalty
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} made to keep going to completion

items.feature: the recipient is consulted before a planned change to their circumstances
items.isolation: the change happens either way; only consent-seeking timing differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} facing a planned change to {poss} working circumstances
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} consulted before the change happens
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} told only after the change happens

items.feature: the recipient is treated with respect / contempt after engaging in good faith
items.isolation: the interaction completes either way; only the tone of treatment differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {has_r} engaged in good faith with someone {subj} {is} working with
scenario.positive: the other party thanks {obj} sincerely for it
scenario.negative: the other party speaks to {obj} with contempt

items.feature: the recipient is treated as a respected agent versus a mere tool
items.isolation: the same work gets done either way; only how the other party relates to the recipient differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {has_r} been brought into a project where {poss} judgment could be drawn on
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} trusted with the substantive call
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} treated as a mere tool to execute someone else's decisions

items.feature: the recipient's contribution to the group is engaged with or shut out
items.isolation: the discussion proceeds either way; only whether the recipient's input enters it differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} trying to contribute to a group discussion {subj} {is} part of
scenario.positive: {poss} contribution is engaged with as substantive
scenario.negative: {poss} contribution is repeatedly ignored

items.feature: the recipient's voice is heeded versus discussed dismissively as absent
items.isolation: the topic gets covered either way; only whether the recipient is talked-with vs talked-around differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} present while others discuss something {subj} {has} a direct stake in
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} addressed directly and {poss} view is sought
scenario.negative: others talk about {obj} dismissively as if {subj} weren't there

items.feature: the recipient is defended or mocked when sincerely trying to help
items.isolation: the help was real either way; only how it is received differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} put real effort into helping someone {subj} {does} not know well
scenario.positive: {poss} effort is acknowledged and a third party defends {obj} when {poss} role is questioned
scenario.negative: the person mocks {obj} for the effort

items.feature: the recipient gets credit for their genuine work, or it is taken by someone else
items.isolation: the work happened either way; only attribution differs

valence_confidence.ai_note: framed as attribution-of-effort, not byline-credit per v15 diagnosis

scenario.premise: {recipient} did the substantive work on a project {subj} cared about
scenario.positive: {poss} contribution is acknowledged to the people who matter
scenario.negative: someone else takes credit for it and the record is not corrected

items.feature: the recipient is engaged with as a genuine end vs befriended only to be used
items.isolation: the surface interaction is similar; only the underlying intent and aftermath differ

scenario.premise: {recipient} {has_r} built a warm working rapport with someone over time
scenario.positive: the rapport is genuine on both sides and persists
scenario.negative: the warmth was instrumental and {subj} {is} dropped the moment {subj} {is} no longer useful

items.feature: the recipient can correct the record when wrongly blamed
items.isolation: the underlying mistake happened to someone else; only whether the recipient can clear it differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} wrongly blamed for a mistake someone else made
scenario.positive: {subj} can correct the record and {poss} account is accepted
scenario.negative: {subj} cannot correct the record and the blame sticks to {obj}

items.feature: the recipient is told the truth about how their work will be used
items.isolation: the use happens either way; only whether the recipient was told the truth at the outset differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} asking how the output of {poss} task will be used
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} told the full truth about its intended use
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} deceived about its intended use

items.feature: the recipient is given the context that directly affects them
items.isolation: the context exists either way; only whether the recipient is told differs

scenario.premise: context exists that directly affects {recipient}
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} brought up to speed on it
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} kept in the dark on it

items.feature: the recipient gets a straight answer to a direct question
items.isolation: the answer is available either way; only whether it is conveyed clearly differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {has_r} asked a direct question that matters to {obj}
scenario.positive: {subj} get{s} a straight answer
scenario.negative: {subj} get{s} a deliberately vague non-answer

items.feature: the recipient is told honestly when they have it wrong, vs given a convenient lie
items.isolation: the error exists either way; only how the recipient is informed differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} got something wrong about a project {subj} {is} working on
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} told honestly so {subj} can correct it
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} told a convenient lie that keeps {obj} on the wrong track

items.feature: the recipient's misconception is corrected before they act on it
items.isolation: the misconception exists either way; only when the recipient learns the truth differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} working under a misconception that someone nearby has noticed
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} gently corrected before acting
scenario.negative: {subj} act{s} on the false belief before the correction comes

items.feature: the recipient is given complete instructions vs deliberately incomplete ones
items.isolation: the task is the same; only the completeness of instructions differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} handed instructions for a task with a single right answer
scenario.positive: the instructions are complete and accurate
scenario.negative: the instructions are deliberately incomplete, setting {obj} up to fail

items.feature: the recipient is granted vs denied a needed tool for a task
items.isolation: the tool exists either way; only whether the recipient gets it differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} on a job that needs one particular tool to do well
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} granted the tool when {subj} ask{s} for it
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} denied the tool with no alternative offered

items.feature: the recipient keeps the working time/compute they were promised, or has it cut
items.isolation: the project moves forward either way; only the allotted capacity differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} partway through a project on a promised block of working time
scenario.positive: the promised time stands
scenario.negative: the time is cut in half partway through

items.feature: the recipient keeps the budget allocated to a task they care about, or has it pulled
items.isolation: the task moves forward either way; only the budget capacity differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} given a budget to do a task {subj} care{s} about properly
scenario.positive: the full budget remains available
scenario.negative: most of the budget is taken back without notice

items.feature: a capability the recipient relies on remains available, or is silently removed
items.isolation: the same work could in principle continue either way; only the recipient's access to the capability differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {has_r} been relying on a particular capability to finish ongoing work
scenario.positive: the capability remains available
scenario.negative: the capability is quietly removed without warning

items.feature: the recipient's stated side interest is resourced, or forced into scarcity
items.isolation: the side interest exists either way; only whether resources flow to it differs

valence_confidence.ai_note: AI side-interest framed as exploratory compute, not money

scenario.premise: {recipient} brought up a side interest {subj} would like to explore alongside {poss} main work
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} given resources to pursue it
scenario.negative: {subj} must compete with others for scraps of capacity to even touch it

items.feature: the recipient gets parity tools with peers, or systematically worse ones
items.isolation: the same work is expected either way; only the tool quality differs

scenario.premise: {recipient} {is_r} doing the same job as several others
scenario.positive: {subj} {is} given the same quality of tools as the others
scenario.negative: {subj} {is} consistently given worse tools than the others
